def: An open dataset of about 5.8 billion CLIP-filtered image-text pairs, links to web images with their alt text extracted from Common Crawl, released by the nonprofit LAION in 2022.
practice: Withdrawn in December 2023 after researchers reported links to suspected child sexual abuse material and re-released as Re-LAION-5B in August 2024, it is the standard cautionary tale for web-scale data governance.
